lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p1-2 - A Listen, and say. Then practise.

details:
Listen and say checks understanding of the job words shown on the map. Say practises first-step pronunciation. 
Practise builds accurate pronunciation and confidence with the target vocabulary through repetition.
Look for careful listening, clear pronunciation of target job words, and confident, steady repetition.
“I’m a teacher, but my friends all have different jobs. Can you listen to their jobs and find where they work on the map?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Break [10m] - B. Listen and say. Then practise

details:
Listen and say checks understanding of location words such as next to, opposite and between. Say practises first-step pronunciation. 
Practise builds accurate pronunciation and confidence with the target vocabulary through repetition.
Look for careful listening, clear pronunciation of locations, and a good understanding of how to ask and answer the questions.
“My friends are coming to the school to talk about their jobs, but the signs fell off every classroom door! Can you help guide them around the school?”
